english: These four, respectively, represent steps in the stage of completion that relate to the four forms of bliss.  With the first two, we engage in the deep practice of the drops.  The third is the recitation of the diamonds; with this we engage in the deep practice of the winds, and then with reference to making the winds and drops suitable for their work we practice, over and over again, using the forward progression to withdraw things into the clear light, and then the reverse progression to rise out of it. acip: DE'I PHYIR SROG DH'U T'IR TSUD PA'I RLUNG STOBS KYIS GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL 'DZIN PA DANG, THEG PA CHE CHUNG THUN MONG BA'I TING NGE 'DZIN SAD DUS GNAS CHA BRTAN PO YOD PA CIG GIS, GNYID DU 'GRO KHAR SNGAR GYI TING NGE 'DZIN LA BZHAG PA NA, GNYID DU GANG SONG BYIN PO 'AM, DE'I STOD TZAM TING NGE 'DZIN DU MER GYIS 'GRO BA'I TING NGE 'DZIN LA, GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL DU 'KHRUL SA CHE BA RNAMS PHYED PA'I RNAM GZHAG GSAL PO YANG MI SNANG ZHING,

english: This then is what We refer to as “The clear light”— The mind and The lightning bolt Are indivisible. And when we remain In this kind of clear light, That's what it means To be staying in emptiness. "Lightning bolt" in this verse refers more specifically to the gradual process of things dissolving into emptiness, and the emptiness then arrived at.
